summary: Iteration 31 - Async Task Polling & Character Gallery in Shots: All backend APIs for async task polling verified working. Frontend character gallery feature in Shots panel works correctly.

issues: Onboarding tutorial modal (z-[100]) blocks UI testing - localStorage flags don't fully prevent it

features_verified.feature: Shots async task polling - generate-shots returns task_id immediately
features_verified.details: Returns {task_id, status: 'pending', message} immediately instead of 520 timeout
Returns {task_id, status, result, error, progress} - properly tracks task state
Progress field (0-100) updates as task processes
Task belongs to user - returns 403 for others, 404 for invalid task_id

features_verified.feature: Video async task polling - animate-hero returns task_id
features_verified.details: Returns task_id for async polling instead of sync wait
Clicking a character shows 'Character's Gallery' with Master image + generated images
Clicking gallery image updates source image in Shots upload area
Button enabled (not disabled) when source image is set from character gallery
VIP users (jamesstephenbrooks@outlook.com) can generate without credit check - usage tracked but not deducted

critical_code_review_comments: Async task polling pattern correctly implemented: POST returns task_id immediately, frontend polls GET /api/tasks/{task_id}
TASK_STORE in-memory dict stores task state with user_id, status, progress, result, error fields
Background tasks use BackgroundTasks from FastAPI to run generation asynchronously
Character gallery in Shots panel implemented via handleShotsCharacterSelect() which calls loadShotsCharacterGallery()
shotsCharacterGallery state properly populated with master + reference + generated images
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing VIP user and characters (Ariza, Dax)
